description: Automated multi-source ingestion pipeline for Northstar Commerce demo. Loads data from 12 source systems with validation gates between stages.

stages.name: meta-bootstrap
stages.description: Initialize meta graph with domains and ontology version

stages.name: jira-ingest
stages.description: Ingest Jira work items (SHOP project) with project hierarchy

stages.name: gitlab-ingest
stages.description: Ingest GitLab merge requests, pipelines, and deployments

stages.name: servicenow-ingest
stages.description: Ingest ServiceNow incidents and change requests

stages.name: confluence-ingest
stages.description: Ingest Confluence wiki pages for knowledge graph

stages.name: figma-ingest
stages.description: Ingest Figma design files, pages, and components

stages.name: code-graph-ingest
stages.description: Load code graph from JSON (code-as-JSON for code graph construction)

stages.name: api-portal-ingest
stages.description: Ingest API service and endpoint definitions

stages.name: observability-ingest
stages.description: Ingest Grafana dashboards, Datadog monitors, Kibana saved objects

stages.name: qtest-ingest
stages.description: Ingest qTest test suites, cases, and runs

stages.name: rally-ingest
stages.description: Ingest Rally epics, features, and user stories

stages.name: crawler-ingest
stages.description: Ingest crawled developer portal and status pages

stages.name: enterprise-pack
stages.description: Load validated enterprise scenario pack with cross-domain graph

stages.name: validation
stages.description: Run graph validation to verify integrity
